collectionExpirySeconds.title: HealthEvents / MaintenanceEvents TTL expireAfterSeconds
collectionExpirySeconds.description: MongoDB TTL index expireAfterSeconds for HealthEvents.createdAt and MaintenanceEvents.actualEndTime. Must be an integer from 0 through 2147483647 (int32). Unset/null defaults to 2592000; do not render as 0 accidentally (MongoDB would delete documents immediately).
